title: Meditation and mental health chatbot
summary: An always-available AI companion for stress and anxiety.
whyTempting: Huge unmet need for mental health support; therapists are scarce.
whyItFails: Safety risk. Handling crises requires clinical oversight. Crowded. Many apps, low differentiation. Retention. People use it when struggling, then stop.
whatWouldChange: Clinically validated AI used alongside human care, paid by employers or health systems.

attempts.notes: Therapy chatbot that started on Facebook Messenger; app closed June 2025.

attempts.outcome: Taken offline after giving harmful advice
attempts.notes: An eating disorder charity replaced its human helpline with the chatbot.

reasons.detail: Safety risk: Handling crises requires clinical oversight.
Retention: People use it when struggling, then stop.
